bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus su rtsod pa'i dus kyi tshe sems can thams cad sdig pa'i sems dang /'thab pa'i sems dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang kun du ldan pa/ pha rol gyi yul rnams la mchog tu zhen pa/ gcig la gcig za ba la brtson pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon gsungs pa'i dus 'jig par byed pa/ dam pa'i chos spong bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams sun 'byin pa de rnams gzhig pa'i thabs gang gis byang chub la mchog tu gzhol bar 'gyur ba'i thabs bstan du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po khyod sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir dang /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /tsho) dge 'dun yang dag par bsrung ba'i phyir 'dri bar byed pa legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig natshongs bshad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe kun du sgra sgrogs ri dzepa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gang la snyoms par zhugs pa de'i tshe dmyal ba thams cad rgyun chad pa dang / sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa thams cad kyang sdang ba'i sems dang bral zhing byang chub kyi sems la rab tu gzhol bar gyur pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsal rgyal khyod kyis mthong ngam / kun du thos sam/ shes sam/ rtogs sam/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags sod/ /khums 3 shing kun du khums yel 'tshal zhing rtogs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/71—817

gsal rgyal 'di ni sems can thams cad kyi ma07sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' skyed pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/ mchod pa/ bsams pa / bsgoms pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgra'i gzugs kyis sems can thams cad yongs su skyong bar byed pa/ mu stegs pa thams cad rnam par 'jig par byed pa/ snang ba'i sems 'dul bar ②byed pa/ sdig pa'i sems 'joms par byed pa/ zhe sdang ba'i sems rnam par sel bar byed pa/ gti mug gi sems rab tu 'jig par byed pa/ 'dod chags kyi sems rnam par spong bar byed pa/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su skyong bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sems 'phel bar byed pa / sangs rgyas 'byung ba bsten gepar byed pa/ 'thab pa dang ske/ 'gyed pa dang / 'khrug pa dang / rtsod pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang ske/ rmi lam ngan pa dang / kun 'dul ba thams cad 'jig par byedasnyepa/glo 'bur gyi nad dang / 'chi ba zhi bar byed pa dang / dus mā yin par 'chi ba dang ske/ rims la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa/ pha rol gyi dpung 'dul bar byed pa / bdud rnam par 'jig par byed pa/ gdung ba sel bar byed pa/ skal ba bzang po yang dag par 'phel bar byed pa/ tshe dang nad med pa ster bar byed pa/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zhi bar byed pa/ thar pa dang dpal 'phel bar byed pa/ gang gis thos nas rjes su yi perang ba de la yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'bras bu rab tu ster ba/ yum na)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gaṇa hā'ishegazugs kyis bzhugs so zhes thos pa dang / gsal rgyal sems dang ba skyes nas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 71—818

'di'i tshad ni ji tsam lags/ mdog ni ci 'dra ba lags/ bye brag ni du zhig lags/ brdungatub ni ci 'dra spub lags/ gang gis brdungakhubar bgyi/gang gi0tshe gang gi dus na ji srid du brdung bar bgyi/ ji ltar gzhag par bgyi/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'byor par 'dod pas shing rnams ni/ /rab tu 'bad de brtag par bya/ /tsan dan bil ba pa la sha /a shad tha dang tsan dan dmar/ /rgya star ta la ging shu ka /shing sha pa dang ta ma la/ /a mra star bu skyu ru ra/ /ting ti sa ra a shosnyika /'di dag thams cad med na yang / /'o se las ni 'bad de bya/ /rgyal po 'bad pas thams cad du/ /'di dag med na mi bya'o/ /tshad med shingapo)ngan las byas dang / /brdungs na sgra ni mi 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas yum 'di brdungs na ni/ /yul 'khor 'tshe ba nges par 'byung / /gtsugasho )lag khang du dge slong rnams/ /de bzhin blo1)ni mi 'thun 7dang / /nye bar gdung ba 'byung 'gyur zhing / /rnam pa du mar rtsod par 'gyur/ /mu stegs can gyi dbang 'gyur zhing / /bdud kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gdug pa'i klu ni du ma yis / /'bru rnams kyang ni nyams par byed/ /rgyal khams 'dir mang sems can rnams/ /rnam par 'jig pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gtsug lag khang yang 'jig 'gyur zhing / /chos kyang nub par 'gyur ba yin/ /bdud kyi lha rnams dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun shin tu ma bsdams byed/ /de ltar yang dag shes nas kyang ske/ /legs par yongs su brtags te bya/ /tshad ni chung ngu sor brgyad kyi/ /brgyad cu57rtsa bzhi nyid bya zhing / /zheng du sor ni drug bya ste/ / 'phang dutsoyang ni gnyis bya'o/ /sor mo'i tshigs kyi tshad dag gis/ /zur bzhir tshad ni 71—819

gnyis pa yin/ /legs mnyam nyid ni shin tu gsal/ /rtse gnyis sbal pa'i mgo bzhin no/ /de nas rdung bar byed pa yang / /shing de nyid las bcad de bya / /sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dag la/ /zlum zhing rtse gnyis no'u le'i mgo/ /chang zungs tshad kyang de bzhin te/ /shin tu 'jam dang rtsibs mnyam par/ /gang phyir de brdungs gzhan dgongs pa/ /'og tu'ang de yi0)khri bya ba/ /gtsug lag khang gi naskusgo stengs sam / /yang na dbus ma'i steng du bya/ / de yis)rab gnas bya ba ni/ /shin tu brtan pa'i chos kyi sku/ /skyed pa ma yin 'jig byed min/ /gdod nas ma skyes pa dge ba/ /de ltar rab gnas byas nas ni/ /de ni spyan dbyer gyur pa yinas/ /gaṇa hā56)spyan dbye byas nas kyang / /de 'og gtsug lag khang kun du/ /klu bdun gyis ni brgyan pa ltar/ /bskyed pa'i rim gyis brdung 57ribar bya/ /de 'og dkon mchog gsum la ni/ /phyag byas nas ni brdung 8bya zhing / / shang rtsa tsho lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /chos kyi rnga rnams brdung bar bya/ /me tog gis ni de bzhin khrus/ /zan za nyi ma 'char nub tshe/ /dus gsum la ni lan gsum ste/ /sku khrus tshe na lan gnyis bsngags/ /glomatshabur gnod pa char mi 'bab/ /de bzhin 'thab dang rtsod pa dang / /glog dang gnod pa chen po dang / /gnas brtan rnams ni spyan 'dren dang / /nad dang mu ge zhi ba'i phyir/ /ma 'tshol rim gyis brdung bar bya/ /dge slong rnams dang dge tshul gyis/ /dus rnams rtag tu brdung ba ste/ /gso sbyong hu1la ni gnas tshe yi / /dge bsnyen gyis kyang brdung bar bya/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa dang ske/ /klu bdun gyis ni 1gebargyan par bya/ /rgyal po gang tshe yul 'khor du/ /gaṇa hā hu de ni gragamanya ragyur pa/ /der ni dpal dang grags pa dang / /'dod pa 71wa 820

dang ni lo legs 'gyur/ /pha rol dpung gis 'jigs med cing / /'bru rnams kyang ni nyams mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs 1'byor pa yis/ /der ni bdud rnams 'dul bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi rnga ni srid rtser bcas/ /kun nas rab tu g.yo bar 'gyur/ /dmyal dang yi dgas 2'jig rten rnams/ /'jig par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /thams cad risangs rgyas rtag dad cing / /thams cad chos la gzhol bar 'gyur/ /deram ni dge 'dun 'dul bar ldan/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams//der ni nub par 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal po tshe ring chos ldan zhing / /bde ba dag dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal po gtsug lag khang kun du/ /chos kyi rnga ni brdungs pa yis/ /sgra ni gang gi rna ba yi/ /lam dag tu ni grag 5gyur cing / /dus bzhi dag tu thos pa 6)ni/ /de rnams byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig snying nas yi rangs pa / /de ni grol 'gyur the tshom med/ /gaṇa ḍi'i 8 mdo ni lan cig ḍa)thos/ /mi de skye ba 7dran par 'gyur/ /gang na mdo sde'i mchog 'di gnas/ /yul 'khor der yang 'byor par 'gyur/ /dus kun du ni gnas pa dang / /klog gam yang na mchod par byed/ /'di ni yid la 'dzin byed pa/ /sdig pa las ni grol bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du phyag byas nas song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' 31stsal nas/thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de 12dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs tenyi /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //71—821

༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ gaṇa ḍi nadas ma ya sru tra/ bod skad du/gaṇa ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur〈5)pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs te/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag la lo rnams kyi dus bshad par bya yis / de legs par pa nyon cig /dge slong rnams dgun zla ra ba'i zla ba 6phyed dang po la ni rkang pa bdun gaṇa ḍi'i dus yin la/ sor gyis 7dman pa'i rkang pa phyed dang lnga ni dus ma yin no//zla ba phyed dang gnyis pa la ni rkang pa brgyad gaṇa ḍi'i dus yin la/ sor gyis dman pa'i rkang pa drug ni dus ma yin no/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i zla ba phyed dang po la ni rkang pa dgu gaṇa ḍi'i dus yin la/ sor gyis dman pa'i rkang pa bdun 71—824

༄ga /'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo/3 ༄7zha /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ka sgyu ṇapha mi tra se ba nipha sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer ku sha na gyad kyi nyenacha 'khor shing sā tshol zung gi tshal na/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas par bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba kho na'i dus kyi tshe dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / dge ba'i grogs po dang /dge ba'i sten yidang gnas par bya'i/ sdig pa'i bshes gnyen dang / sdig pa'i grogs po dang / sdig pa'i sten〈pedang gnas par mi bya'o zhes dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang 71—829
